runtime_probe.error: URLError:<urlopen error [Errno -3] Temporary failure in name resolution>

technical_reason: The existing schema-v3 READY network task remained unclaimed for more than 15 minutes. The tracked script, canonical three-row input, source manifest and preflight record were read back. The default /usr/bin/python lacked shapely, so the same unmodified script was executed with the available /opt/pyvenv/bin/python environment containing shapely. One bounded official LambethAirQualityZone service-metadata request then failed during DNS resolution; no layer was selected and no point query was issued.
